thread:
maria: Heads-up — noticing a big LCP/regression from the EU canary after the 11:02 deploy. Charts blank for ~2s before first paint. Radar shows main-thread parse spike. Anyone else?
eli: yep, saw the RUM traces too. parseSelfTime jumps from ~300ms to ~1.2s on the canary group.
sam: artifact sizes? did something pull a big dependency in?
maria: quick diff of build artifacts: bundle-main.js gz changes: 450KB -> 1.1MB. The big delta is a telemetry import (telemetry-proxy).
aisha: that import was supposed to be tree-shaken — are sourcemaps or locales inlined now?
ryan: grabbed a flamechart from a slow session:
```
Main Thread
└─ parse/compile (telemetry-proxy.js) ~900ms
   └─ eval (inlined sourcemap) ~400ms
```
maria: looks like sourcemap inlining + a non-lazy telemetry module. Canary deploy id 2024-10-12_1102.
deploy-bot: Canary 2024-10-12_1102 deployed to eu-canary (id: canary-1102) — metric alerting tied to LCP triggered.
eli: probable root causes ordered: 1) telemetry-proxy switched from dynamic import -> direct import (rollup change), 2) source maps accidentally embedded in prod bundle, 3) vendor chunk strategy collapsed.
sam: I can repro locally by building with the canary flag — confirmed telemetry-proxy ended up in main bundle and its inlined map increased parse time.
aisha: quick mitigation = rollback canary or hotfix to lazy-load telemetry. Which do we want?
maria: we should rollback the canary to stop user impact, then push hotfix split. rollback takes 10m.
ryan: agree. I can trigger rollback now. After rollback we can ship split change as a patch.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: canary-1102 -> rollback to canary-1089. ETA: 6 minutes.
eli: for the hotfix: propose code change: replace `import telemetry from "./telemetry-proxy"` with:
```
const Telemetry = React.lazy(() => import("./telemetry-proxy"));
// and mount inside <Suspense fallback={null}> so initial paint isn't blocked
```
sam: also add explicit chunk name and ensure sourcemaps are external: in rollup config set `sourcemap: true` and `inline: false` for prod.
aisha: I'll prepare a small PR that does both: dynamic import + rollup sourcemap fix + ensure telemetry import lives in vendor-telemetry chunk. Keeps patch small.
maria: +1. Can we add a QA check in CI to fail builds where main bundle gz > 600KB? just as a guardrail.
eli: we should, but make it opt-in for now. I'll open a follow-up ticket for bundle-size gating and a rule for importing heavy deps.
ryan: rollback finished — metrics back to normal in 30s on the canary group.
deploy-bot: Canary rollback completed (canary-1102 -> 1089).
sam: PR prepared: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4923 — small diff, 5 lines to lazy import plus rollup tweak.
aisha: running canary build with my PR now and will smoke test in eu region. posting results in 10m.
maria: thanks team. After we verify, let's schedule a controlled canary with telemetry off by default until we validate parse times.
eli: note for postmortem: add checklist item to review any changes that convert dynamic imports -> static ones (rollup plugin config, IDE autofixes).
maria: ok closing here once canary passes. Will follow up in eng-platform with the PR link and perf numbers. :thumbsup:
